for_sales.sales_text:
Iconic & Beloved. Single-family ownership from new; meticulously maintained and wintered ashore under cover every year. Overhauled Mechanics. Repowered with a Yanmar 1GM10 (9hp) diesel in 2001; complete engine-out overhaul and bay strip/repaint in 2024.

Rigging & Sails

Traditional gaff rig with varnished spruce spars (tabernacle-mounted for easy lowering). Extensive tan sail wardrobe (Mainsail, Jib, Staysails, Topsails). Standing/running rigging regularly updated (Backstays NEW 2024).

Condition & Deck

Striking racing-green GRP hull with centreboard, spruce bowsprit, and beautifully finished iroko/ply brightwork (Deks Olje). Deep, safe cockpit.

Accommodation

Bright, cozy mahogany interior. V-berth forecabin with toilet, main saloon with drop-leaf table, and updated galley (2-burner hob/grill NEW 2023).

LOA / LWL 7.35m / 6.00m

Beam / Draft 2.44m / 1.42m (Centreboard down)

Displacement 2,086

Yanmar 1GM10 9hp Shaft Drive (25L Diesel Tank)

2x 12V batteries, alternator, solar trickle charger, battery management

Inventory Included

Compass, Fixed DSC VHF, NASA Depth Sounder & Clipper Wind, Nav lights, Clock

Fishermans & Bruce anchors, warps, fenders, boathook, sail cover.

Horseshoe buoy, throwing line, fire extinguisher, Whale bilge pump, horn, gas detector.
